articles.title: Why the world’s second-largest Bitcoin mining power is shutting down rigs in its capital city
articles.snippet: The Energy Ministry enacted the year-round restriction to mitigate power capacity shortages, as energy-intensive mining facilities continue to strain regional grids.

articles.title: Cluster of headwinds weigh on bitcoin. XRP teeters near $1
articles.snippet: Top cryptocurrencies nurse losses as regulatory picture sours. ETF flows and traditional markets offer little support.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward revenue rises 17% as trading volume falls in Q2
articles.snippet: Payward grew revenue despite weaker crypto spot activity, as funded accounts jumped 42% and a growing share of revenue came from outside transaction-based activity.

articles.title: Gemini posts $108M Q2 net loss despite 37% revenue growth
articles.snippet: Credit card and staking revenue drove Gemini’s services growth in Q2 as exchange revenue fell 38% and trading volume dropped by two-thirds.

articles.title: Shinhan Asset Management partners with Plume on tokenized fund pilot
articles.snippet: Shinhan Asset Management and Plume will test a tokenized fund using a Korean won-denominated ultra-short-term bond fund as its underlying asset.
